entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: A timid Serra Angel artificer who is guardian and chief engineer of the new Skyship Weatherlight.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship powered by a powerstone containing Serra's Realm, crewed by Jhoira.

entities.name: Cathedral of Serra
entities.description: Where Tiana was created as a Guardian Angel.

entities.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: Angel who tasked Tiana with protecting the Great Machine.

entities.name: Great Machine
entities.description: An irrigation system of lifts and engines carrying water up a plateau; destroyed by the Cabal.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Faction that destroyed the Great Machine.

entities.name: Liliana
entities.description: Saved by Tiana from an attack by Urgoros.

entities.name: Urgoros
entities.description: Attacker of Liliana at the Cabal Stronghold.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion of Dominaria during which Tiana served on the Weatherlight.

entities.name: New Coalition
entities.description: Alliance Tiana supported against the invasion.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: Freed by Tiana and her companions.

entities.name: Slimefoot
entities.description: Retrieved by Tiana with the powerstone.

events.summary: Tiana is created as a Guardian Angel in the Cathedral of Serra and tasked by Lyra Dawnbringer to protect the Great Machine.
events.quote: She was specifically tasked by Lyra Dawnbringer with the protection of the Great Machine

events.summary: The Cabal destroys the Great Machine before Tiana can see it.
events.quote: the Great Machine was destroyed by the Cabal before she could set her eye on it

events.summary: The church appoints Tiana to guard the recovery and rebuilding of the Weatherlight.
events.quote: Tiana was appointed by the church to guard the recovery and rebuilding of the ship

events.summary: When the Weatherlight attacks the Cabal Stronghold, Tiana saves Liliana from an attack by Urgoros.
events.quote: Tiana was in the midst of the fight and saved Liliana from an attack by Urgoros

events.summary: Tiana helps free Braids alongside Shanna Sisay and Rafwyn Capashen during the New Phyrexian invasion.
Tiana retrieves Slimefoot and the powerstone, lamenting her second failure to protect her charge.
events.quote: lamenting her second failure to protect her charge

relations.quote: saved Liliana from an attack by Urgoros
the Great Machine was destroyed by the Cabal
